data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue
data.body:
Hi,

BARD ASSOCIATES INC's most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in FIP and PCYO.

On August 25, 2026, PCYO disclosed a director or officer change in an 8-K Item 5.02 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/276720/000110465926100607/pcyo-20260824x8k.htm).

I publish Local Ledger, an independent research publisher using public records only, never issuer-paid. May I send the free weekly issue and outline a four-week fund pilot?

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.

Andrew
Founder, Local Ledger
